Class PlayerRankDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.DTO.PlayerRankDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PlayerRankDTO extends Object implements Serializable
A detailed Data Transfer Object (DTO) capturing a player's complete performance metrics at the conclusion of a game session.

This class encapsulates not only the final structural position (rank) and a winning flag, but also explicit game resource evaluations—such as accumulated prestige points and final food supplies—which are vital for client-side scoreboard breakdowns and tiebreaker transparency.

      protected PlayerRankDTO()

    • PlayerRankDTO

      public PlayerRankDTO(String nickname, int prestigePoints, int foodAmount, int position, boolean isWinner)
      Constructs a fully populated PlayerRankDTO with individual scoring and resource metrics.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the unique profile name identifying the player
      prestigePoints - the total primary victory/prestige points accumulated by the end of the match
      foodAmount - the remaining food resources owned by the player, often used as a tiebreaker metric
      position - the final placement or rank position standing (e.g., 1 for first place)
      isWinner - true if this player qualifies as a winner of the match; false otherwise

    • isWinner

      public boolean isWinner()
      Checks whether this specific player has achieved a victory state in the completed session.

      Note that multiple players may return true simultaneously in the event of an absolute, unresolved tie (shared victory scenario).

      Returns:
      true if this player is a winner; false otherwise
